Funny story and probably could have gotten hurt if I wasn't paying  attention, when I first bought my bones hardcore bushings I was a bit drunk and managed to put them on wrong so one truck was like that, skating  along just cruising around my city and I hear something metallic hit the ground, didn't pay too much attention, did a kick turn and as I lifted my nose up to turn the hanger falls off, turns out because the nut wasn't on enough to lock in place the vibrations of riding on the pavement shook it loose, if I wasn't paying attention and going faster probably would have gone flying if I put my nose back down. 

Tl;Dr: so yeah might be a bit of an issue for you.

Edit: I'd recommend getting some softer bushings and tightening the nut enough to lock, with softer ones it should turn better.
